title: feat(panel): add Panel widget
body:
The panel widget adds a way to wrap other widgets to add templates (headers, footers) and utility features (collapsing and hiding the widget).

## Motivation

Using headers and footers wrapping a widget is a common need to give more context to the user when interacting with the widget.

React InstantSearch provides a `Panel` widget to wrap any other InstantSearch component:

```js
<Panel header="All brands">
  <RefinementList attributes="brands" />
</Panel>
```

Up until InstantSearch.js 2, widgets had `header` and `footer` templates, in addition to [`autoHideContainer`](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets-common-api.html#autohidecontainer) and [`collapsible`](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets-common-api.html#collapsible) options. The panel widget solves these needs, deferring the responsability from the widget itself to the panel widget.

## Usage

```js
const refinementListWithPanel = panel({
  templates: {
    header: 'Header',
    footer: 'Footer',
    // or with functions
    header: ({ results }) => `Header | ${results.nbHits} results`,
  },
  hidden: ({ results }) => results.nbHits === 0,
})(refinementList);

search.addWidget(
  refinementListWithPanel({
    attribute: 'brands',
  })
);
```

The `hidden` property drives the `noRefinement` CSS class.
